SAMAN Portable manufactures porta cabins in Moradabad as a direct factory, not a marketplace reseller. We have built modular steel cabins — porta cabins, also called portable cabins — since 2009, and completed 500+ projects across India. Units for Moradabad are fabricated at our Greater Noida works and sent by road to sites across the city, the Lakri Fazalpur brass belt, and the Majhola industrial side. At about 160–190 km, most Moradabad orders reach the site in 2–3 days once the build is ready.

A porta cabin is a factory-built steel cabin that arrives finished and ready to use. It gives you a clean, lockable, weather-proof room without the time, cost, and mess of on-site civil construction. For a city known worldwide as Peetal Nagri — its brass and metal-handicraft export units, electroplating and finishing works, engineering, and packaging across the Lakri Fazalpur and Majhola belts — a porta cabin is the fastest way to put a site office, staff room, or security post exactly where the work is.

How we build our porta cabins

Every unit starts with a mild steel frame in IS 2062 structural steel, welded and treated to resist rust through Moradabad's hot summers and cold, foggy winters. The base sits on a channel frame so the cabin stays off wet or dusty ground. Walls use insulated PUF sandwich panels, or cement board with rockwool, so the inside stays comfortable in both the peak heat and the January cold. The roof is profiled GI sheet with a slope for rain runoff. Flooring is marine ply with vinyl for office use, or chequered MS plate for heavy gate and store cabins. A standard fit-out covers electrical wiring with switches, points, LED lights and an MCB distribution board, powder-coated windows with grille and shutter, and a steel or laminated door with a lock. We add air-conditioning, toilets with plumbing, pantry units, and internal partitions when a site needs them.

Common porta cabin sizes for Moradabad sites

Popular configurations are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft for a single supervisor, guard, or weighbridge cabin, 20×8 ft (the standard shipping-container footprint) for a site office that seats a small team, and 40×8 ft for larger project offices with two or three rooms. We also fabricate to custom dimensions, and stack units in double-decker form where ground space is tight — a common request on packed Lakri Fazalpur and Majhola plots. If you are unsure of the size, tell us the headcount and how the cabin will be used and we will suggest a layout that fits your plot.

Where porta cabins are used around Moradabad

Buyers in the Moradabad region use our porta cabins as admin and supervisor offices inside brass, handicraft, and electroplating units in the Lakri Fazalpur belt (244001), staff and store cabins for engineering and packaging plants on the Majhola industrial side (244103), gate and security cabins for factories and export warehouses, weighbridge and billing cabins for logistics yards, and portable offices for the many small workshops across the city (244001). For teams setting up on raw ground, we build hardened site-office porta cabins with heavier flooring and extra power points for tools and equipment.

Customization and price factors

Because every unit is made to order, the porta cabin price in Moradabad depends on the size, the panel type (PUF costs more than cement board but insulates far better through the harsh winters), the flooring, and add-ons like air-conditioning, a toilet, a pantry, or extra electrical load for machines. Colour, branding, window and door count, and internal partitions are all your choice. We confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion rather than showing a fixed sticker price that would not match your actual build — so you pay for the cabin you need, not a template. Compare our specifications against any marketplace listing: the difference is that you are dealing with the factory that welds the frame, not an agent forwarding your enquiry to someone else.

Delivery, warranty, and certifications

Delivery to Moradabad is charged at ₹3,000 where applicable, with road transit of about 2–3 days once the unit is ready — Moradabad is close to our Greater Noida factory, so it is one of our quicker deliveries. We also offer a 7-day return window, with return shipping paid by the customer. SAMAN Portable operates under ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and is registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our porta cabins carry a 5-year structural frame and base warranty, 1–2 years on finishing, and a 20–25 year engineered service life for the steel structure — real, verifiable credentials that a marketplace listing cannot show you.

Porta cabin vs conventional construction in Moradabad

A permanent site room built in brick ties up labour and material for weeks and leaves you with something that cannot move. A porta cabin removes both problems. It is fabricated at our works while your site keeps running, then delivered to Lakri Fazalpur, Majhola, or your project ground ready to occupy — no curing time, no debris, no wasted material if the plan changes. For brass and handicraft export units that need a billing office or a security cabin quickly, that speed is the difference between waiting a month and working the same week. Because the cabin is bolted steel, it relocates cleanly when the work moves, and one fixed quote covers the finished unit instead of an open-ended civil bill. Most Moradabad buyers weigh three things — how fast it arrives, whether the price is firm, and whether it can move later — and a made-to-order porta cabin answers all three.

Why buy your porta cabin from SAMAN

Search for a porta cabin on a directory and you get a page of resellers competing on the same stock photos. Enquire with SAMAN and you reach the manufacturer directly — honest specifications, real size options, transparent price factors, and one point of accountability from fabrication to dispatch. See how we manage porta cabin manufacturing for Moradabad orders, and if your site also needs a larger office consider our container offices supplied around Moradabad. Our work across the northern belt — porta cabins supplied throughout Noida, cabins we build for Lucknow sites, and porta cabin deliveries into Kanpur — shows the same build quality reaches every site in the region.

Frequently asked questions

Do you deliver porta cabins to Moradabad and the Lakri Fazalpur industrial area?
Yes. We manufacture at our Greater Noida factory and dispatch by road to Moradabad city (244001), the Lakri Fazalpur brass belt (244001), and the Majhola industrial side (244103). Transit is usually 2–3 days once the unit is built, with delivery charged at ₹3,000 where applicable.

What porta cabin sizes are available for Moradabad sites?
Common sizes are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft cabins, 20×8 ft site offices, and 40×8 ft project offices. We also build custom dimensions and double-decker units for packed Lakri Fazalpur and Majhola plots.

What does a porta cabin cost in Moradabad?
Price depends on size, panel type, flooring, and add-ons like AC or a toilet. Since every unit is made to order, we confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion so the figure matches your exact build.

Can the porta cabin be customised for factory, site, and security use?
Yes. We add AC, toilets, pantries, partitions, extra power points, and heavier flooring for gate or store use, and we match the layout, colour, and window and door count to your site.

Talk to the manufacturer. For porta cabins anywhere in the Moradabad region, call our North zone team on +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details for a made-to-order quote.
